2. Reason: The plan tells WebSurfer to find “the number of Reference Works” for Life Sciences and Health Sciences in 2022, which risks retrieving only a single total per area. A sample standard deviation requires multiple data points (e.g., counts per sub-domain within each area). Without explicitly instructing to collect per-subdomain counts, the standard deviation cannot be computed. Additionally, it conflates “as of 2022” with “for the year 2022,” risking use of a 2022-only publication filter rather than a 2022 snapshot of total counts, which could produce incorrect data.
